name: Reinstatement With a Start Date Change Pending Approval
description: FLP-2089 (reinstatement path). SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship, Commitments approves it, then SLD DELETEs it. SLD then POSTs the learner again with the StartDate moved to the 13th, which reinstates the same learning (matched on learner, UKPRN and course code, not start date). The reinstated episode is still approved, so Learning flags the start date change FurtherApprovalNeeded. The outer API should ask Approvals, and the local stub answers EmployerApprovalRequested (pending), so Earnings should take the new start date and also flag the episode, sending a WithholdPaymentsForLearningEvent. EXPECTED TO FAIL before the reinstatement fix: the outer create path never asks Approvals and always tells Earnings FurtherApprovalRequired = false, so the Earnings flag assertion fails. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally (the storybook checks before running): the expected events are waited for, then the ones that must not appear are checked.

steps.name: SLD Reinstates the Apprenticeship With the Start Date on the 13th (Approvals answers pending)

assertions.name: Learning single price starts on the reinstated start date
Learning episode is reinstated, still approved, and needs further approval
Earnings has the reinstated start date
The learning is reinstated and Earnings withholds payments for it
No change is echoed to Approvals
